column1: # Images that docker/setup-buildx-action and docker/setup-qemu-action pull when a
# job sets up a builder (CHAOS-9064). Both default to Docker Hub, and an
# anonymous pull from a hosted runner fails once the shared IP uses up Docker
# Hub's rate limit. CI takes them from the ghcr.io mirror instead, by digest.
# The golang row is the Go builder base of docker/go-worker.Dockerfile and
# resolve flakes, so the Dockerfiles pull ghcr.io/<owner>/library/golang instead.
# <name><TAB><upstream ref: repo:tag@sha256:<digest of the multi-arch INDEX>>
# mirror-test-images.yml reads this file, copies each ref verbatim into
# ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>:<tag> (same digest), and verifies the digest and that
# the index holds linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. Workflows use
# holds every setup-buildx / setup-qemu step to the digests below.
# To bump an image: put the new index digest here, update the digest in the
# workflow steps the test names, and let mirror-test-images.yml publish it
# (it runs on a push to main that touches this file, or dispatch it on the branch).
